title: How does sleep change with age?
subtitle: Evidence-based answer to the common question: how does sleep change with age?
evidence_strength: Established evidence for age-related changes in sleep architecture and circadian rhythms; moderate to emerging evidence on interventions and individual variability; limitations include heterogeneity of older adult populations and comorbidities affecting generalizability.
